orders.judge: Hon'ble Mr. Justice Lok Pal Singh
orders.text:
Stay Application No. 1285 of 2018 
Application for Leave to Appeal No. 1286 of 2018 
Delay Condonation Application No. 1689 of 2018 
In 
F.A. No. 13 of 2018
Hon’ble V.K. Bist, J.
Mr. Aditya Singh, Advocate for 
the applicant. 
Mr. I.P. Kohli, Advocate for the 
respondents. 
Heard. 
There is delay of 26 days’ in filing 
this Appeal. 
Reasons stated in the application 
for condonation of delay are 
satisfactory. Hence, delay condonation 
application is allowed and the delay in 
filing the Appeal stands condoned. 
Application for leave to appeal is 
allowed. Leave is granted. 
Admit. 
Summon the lower court’s record. 
List this matter on 07.05.2018. 
Considering the submission of 
the learned counsel for the parties, it 
is directed that, till the next date of 
listing, parties shall maintain status 
quo in respect of property in question. 
It is also directed that third party 
interest shall not be created. It is 
observed that, in case, any 
construction is raised over the 
property in question that will be 
subject to final outcome of this appeal. 
Stay application stands disposed 
of.  Parties are directed to prepare 
the paper book. Registry is directed to 
supply necessary papers to the 
counsel for the parties for preparation 
of paper book. 
 (V.K. Bist, J.) 
 08.03.2018
Navin
